body:
T-0:00
Taken 100mg of bk-2C-B weighed on a scale and mixed in soda. Drank the mix.
T-1:00
Not noticing too much. Just a little time dilation and cleaner colors. I notice things more. Feeling different. No noticeable psychedelic visuals.
T-2:30
Added 50mg bk-2C-B weighed on a scale. Mixed in soda and drank it. Go into thought and feel like they are scrambled, but more thoughts come about society just doesn't have enough songs about doing good and going green. They only sing about gangs and fighting. Thinking why can't we have a society where the 1% don't own 40% of the world's wealth. Since when has it been preferable to live in a society with gangs, war, poverty, and pollution instead of a world with good schools, going green, no poverty, and a lot of hippies.
I decided to clean my room. Surfed the web. Watched trippy video and funny videos. bk2C-B expanded awareness of the subconscious mind and while scrambled at first, the thoughts became more clear. Nootropic? It's not good for menial tasks, but may aid in studying and writing reports. It's almost like a smart drug. No tripping, but abstract thought enhancement. Trippier thoughts?
T-4:00
Took 25mg prolintane and 50mg Phenylpiracetam hydrazide in water. The bk-2C-B seemed to enhance the effects of these nootropics considerably. Still no tripping, just abstract thoughts and increased distractability by reading, watching movies based on history, and a funny video.
T-7:00 thinking of how I'm going to sleep. Maybe a couple of benzos and some hydroxyzine?
